exposure: Use of military medical treatment facilities (MTFs)
outcome: Population coverage rates within 30-minute catchment areas for medical facilities capable of providing emergency cesarean delivery care
cohort: TRICARE beneficiaries and civilian populations in the continental US
finding: This study found that 58.6% of MTFs capable of providing emergency cesarean delivery care were located in areas with the potential to improve access to obstetric care within a 30-minute travel time.
mod_finding: The study investigated access to emergency cesarean delivery care but did not report on mode of delivery rates.
